The '''D'rinba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained [[D'rinba IV]]. The system was visited by the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] while en route to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The Corellian Trade Spine also ran through it.
